# Cat source

Original: **Cat**, Animal Pack Vol.2 by Quaternius, published 3 November 2017.

- Author's upload and licence declaration: https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly
- Source archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Animal%20Pack%20Vol.2%20by%20%40Quaternius.zip
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Retrieved 9 September 2026. Only the cat source is retained here.

`quaternius-cat.blend` is the original rigged mesh. The source has Idle and Walking actions. `scripts/build_cats.py` customises Pearl's grey/white and Maree's calico materials, face details and proportions, and authors additional sit, sleep, groom, jump and crouch poses. It renders every direction independently. No game sprites were copied.

The derivative source blends and approved sprites use the same CC0 source permission. Credit is retained voluntarily for provenance.
